crossRefs.note: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to…
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the…
This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill…
Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan…
Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there…
Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land…

translations.web: and gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
translations.bsb: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
translations.asv: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
